notes.title: What to expect from fishTDX...
notes.content:
Hello!

Firstly, thanks to everyone for playing the game! It's been super cool to see people enjoying it! I have heaps planned before I move on to other projects, and I'm dedicated to making fishTDX as good as it can be.

[h2]What's planned[/h2]

So what's planned?

Well, there definitely needs to be some big changes made to improve player experience. Fundamental changes that will vastly improve various different aspects of the game. The goal I have with these subsequent updates is to improve the following key areas.

[b]Shop[/b]

[list]
[*] Clearly divide towers and affixes
[*] Increase roll price with roll
[*] Add a shop upgrade system (think SNKRX)
[*] Add a percentage system for lower tier towers
[/list]

[b]Plots[/b]

[list]
[*] Add start and end pointers to plots
[*] Make it so you add plots every X rounds rather than every round
[*] Add a plot drafting system. You get three plots to choose from and you decide where to place them.
[/list]

[b]Metaprogression[/b]

[list]
[*] Decrease the pack sizes so there aren't too many synergies in any one pack
[*] Redo the packs menu to show locked packs
[*] Add a metacurrency to unlock new packs
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list]
[*] Make the tutorial more involved
[*] Make alerts different colours
[*] Redo the stats tab to be more intuitive and appear on hover
[*] Add a post game summary of each tower's performance
[*] Make it clearer how beneficial an affix has been on a particular tower
[/list]

[b]Optimisations[/b]

[list]
[*] Pretty much just make the game run smoother
[/list]

[b]Content?[/b]

[list]
[*] Will be on hold (Sorry!)
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

So that is heaps and heaps of stuff. Super exciting! They will all be part of fishTDX 2.0, a massive shift with better design decisions, and hopefully a smoother player experience with more strategy and more fun! I hope you're all as excited as I am!

However this is a lot of stuff to do. Some bullet-points will be quick 2-3 day things to fix, but others might take weeks or even months to overhaul to a point where I'm happy with it. I am currently enrolled in university, and I have a constant stream of work to do for that. Additionally, I work 12 hours a week at a part time role, and I tutor other students. I hardly have any time to even think about fishTDX, let alone dive into the codebase to implement a massive new feature.

What this means, is that the game's development will be paused (for major features) during the rest of this semester, which is about another 8-10 weeks depending on when my exams are. I will remain active [url=https://discord.gg/KVxEeGHNFn]on Discord[/url] to fix any bugs or balancing issues, but that'll be about it unfortunately.

But 8-10 weeks isn't [i]that[/i] far away, and I'll start working on new stuff as soon as I get an opportunity to! My current priorities are the following:

[olist]
[*] plots
[*] metaprogression
[*] optimisations
[*] gameplay
[*] shop
[/olist]

It has definitely become clear to me that fishTDX may have been more suited for an Early Access release, considering the amount of massive features that have been added over time (and will continue to be added), but either way, the game will get even better over time. 

[h2]Other stuff[/h2]

Not all is lost though! I have written, and will soon begin editing a new video on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@progress_games]my YouTube channel[/url] discussing bugTDX! Depending on how that video performs, I will then dive into the development of fishTDX! 

Also we have hit 400 sales, which is super sick! Again, please leave a review if you haven't already! Massive thanks to [url=https://www.youtube.com/live/vQWrHZ44lrc?si=9JWOt7gUa1mnLYSm]PepperHead[/url] for playing the game on stream and providing some legendary feedback (which inspired many of these changes). And, thanks to you for reading. 

Happy fishing! 🎣

notes.title: The Creation Update is here!
notes.content:
[h1]New content![/h1]

As this update was mainly focused on a major new feature (see more below...), the content is a little lighter than future updates will be. However there should be plenty to dig your teeth into!

[b]new affixes[/b]
plague: give a tower plague (enemies create a poison explosion on death)
extra pocket: tower has 2 extra affix slots
pepper: tower has a chance to sneeze
devoted: increase tower's immolate value

[b]new elite[/b]
blazing: immune to slow damage

[h1]Create your own packs![/h1]

The most significant feature [i]by far[/i] in this update is the new pack creator! You can now create new packs, duplicate existing packs, and edit your own custom packs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759782/1174c36a45f3d682cbc4f451417188e902cacbcc.png[/img]

These open up the game [i]massively[/i] as you can create your own challenges, and discover new synergies between towers that don't share a pack. [u]Plus[/u], to celebrate this new feature, I'm going to add[b] 1 user-made pack [/b]to the base game next update, so please join our Discord to share your creation and have your pack immortalised in fishTDX!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759782/044bb17f539d603afb44b986ec89013633a897cb.png[/img]

Be wary though, you can only create packs with towers you've used at some point, so make sure to try out as many towers and affixes as you can so you can use them in your packs! You can put [u]any tower in any tier[/u], there's no restrictions. You can even take inspiration from Tisajokt's pack 'overstimulated' and add duplicates of a tower so it appears more frequently in the shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759782/88b303a278148a66885cd01f1e3630664b75b261.png[/img]

I'd love to add workshop support sometime in the future, but until then you can share packs with each other by finding them in the game's save files located here: C:\Users\[you]\AppData\Roaming\fishTDX

[h1]Bugfixes and QoL things[/h1]

fixed crashes around plot creation tools
updated the way packs are stored to accommodate for duplicate names
fixed scrollbar in packs menu
fixed some affixes not applying an effect properly
fixed shattered ice crash
added immolate value to tower tab
moved a lot of stuff in packs around to make more sense and enable synergies

[h1]Next Update[/h1]

I know I said this update was going to be very health focused, but I wanted to get these custom packs out sooner rather than later. The next update will add some new achievements for those achievement-hunters, as well as some new funky towers and interesting effects!

On another note, we're almost at 20 reviews! Please leave a review if you haven't already - it goes such a long way and I love reading them. Massive thank you all for playing and happy fishing! 🎣

notes.title: The Good & Evil Update is here!
notes.content:
[h2]New content![/h2]

[b]new plot[/b]
Metropolis: all towers gain 1.5x damage but charge 10 rent

[b]new artifacts[/b]
Free Parking: tower placed on top does not charge rent
Parking Meter: all towers have 1.5x damage but charge an additional 10 rent
Skyscraper: diagonal towers generate 1 hp per round

[b]new towers[/b]
Dark Lord: immolate adjacent towers for darkness
Holy Lord: immolate adjacent towers for lightness

[b]new affix[/b]
Shattered Ice: adds shatter when freeze breaks

[h2]Updated packs page![/h2]

The packs page went through a much needed update. Each pack now has a 'plots pool' in addition to the tower pool that determines the possible plots that you can encounter using that plot. This reduces redundant plots confusing new players like the 'Beach' plot and 'Archipelago' plot. Check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759782/bd5c98025cd8ff9bd21eabb892bd62298b309d19.png[/img]

[h2]Bugfixes and QoL things![/h2]

fixed money and lives text overlapping
fixed the '-' for the info tab being in the wrong position
hopefully fixed roll cost text overlapping
reworded DNA
added a setting to use right click for start wave to avoid accidentally clicking it

Thanks for playing (and reading this far!) The game has officially sold 300 sales! Super stoked that we hit this amazing milestone and I couldn't have done it without you all (duh lol). If you have issues please join [url=https://discord.gg/KVxEeGHNFn]our Discord[/url] or post something in the Discussions! If you haven't already, please leave a review too!

This was a bit smaller than I would've liked but I wanted to get the packs update out as fast as possible. The next update will be very 'health' oriented...

Happy fishing! 🎣

Welcome to build v0.3, a new and improved look for fishTDX!

notes.title: fishTDX is now a part of the Steam Endless Replayability Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]

The demo for fishTDX is now live as part of Steam's Endless Replayability Fest! 🥳🥳

[h2]What does it have?[/h2]

Unlike other demos, fishTDX offers a full game experience with an expansive collection of items to discover and interact with! It's fully features with a unique soundtrack by [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/5bRBW0KuYJPNz1L0BmfxYt?si=004933cca8c447f4]st3d[/url], hundreds of pieces of art by me, and tons of synergies for you to discover!

[h3]Tons of towers[/h3]

As promised, there are [i]over 70[/i] towers in fishTDX. As you play, you'll unlock packs in which you can experiment with different synergies, tower combinations, and strategies. Not only are there tons of towers, but there are many affixes to level up your towers and provide additional strategic depth.

[h3]Different plot types[/h3]

And speaking of strategic depth, there are [i]10 different plot types[/i] (the little coloured islands) each with their own unique multipliers, and decorations that add an entirely new layer of strategy as you decide where you should place your strongest tower to make the most of it, or perhaps your weakest tower to enhance it...

I'd love to hear what you think!

[url=https://discord.gg/KVxEeGHNFn]We'd love to have you in the official progress games discord![/url]

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfaIJ_9gpdornP4AqsuUhcyfELrvDAfFsSsKimuE-ys-pFCkQ/viewform?usp=sf_link]And please fill out this feedback form![/url]

Happy fishing! 🎣
